d: In this video, Firstpost explains that HBO’s highly anticipated Harry Potter TV series has unveiled its first look at the iconic Hogwarts banquet scene, but the reveal has left fans divided. The Harry Potter reboot, set to premiere on Christmas Day, is facing criticism over its visual effects, with some viewers claiming the CGI looks worse than the original 2001 film, Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone. Others have taken aim at the production quality, sparking a wave of memes and online reactions. In this video, Firstpost looks at why the new Harry Potter series is facing backlash…
